text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The big day, the Oka Sho, draws near.
Endless thoughts linger over whether or not
to continue down the Triple Tiara route, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume at the School Gate
text_block_list.text:
Well then, everyone, thank you for waiting!
The Spring Fan Appreciation Festival is now open!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fans
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is the day of the 'Fan Appreciation Festival,' where countless fans visit the academy grounds, and the Umamusume get to enjoy participating in various sports events...
choice_data_list: (I hope this helps her take her mind off things, even just a little...)
(I hope this helps her feel a little refreshed...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
There is a competition I'd like to go watch.
...May I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we headed over to watch the cavalry battle,
which featured one of the Umamusume she looked up to, Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Teams of three, where two act as the base 'carriers'
and one serves as the 'rider' atop them,
with riders competing to snatch each other's headbands, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Sweep,
are you sure you're okay with this event?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, 'is it okay?'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, how should I put it... build and power really play a huge role in this sport, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"If we talk about 'riders,' we'll end up
getting into a real clash over it.
...Should we switch roles at least?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Instead of us,
maybe a group of smaller girls could be the 'carriers' or something...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: N-Nooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm the "rider"!
You guys are the "carriers"!
And that's that, end of story!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... Isn't there some kind of trouble over there?
Wait, ah, it's the Sweep Tosho group.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if she'll be okay...
Being small really is a disadvantage after all, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
...Just you watch!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Realistically speaking, won't it be difficult for them to win?"
...Before the race began, such was the mood
cast over the Sweep Tosho team.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, once the competition began—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOO!?)

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
S-Sweep Tosho!!
Team Sweep Tosho has pulled it off again!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"And with that... bringing the total to a whopping 39 points!
What an overwhelmingly decisive victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, is that even allowed?!
Breaking away solo and leaping
all over the other horseriders like that?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and the others timing it so perfectly to reach the landing spot is amazing on its own, but……
to pull off something so unconventional is just unreal!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Time's up!!
The winner is Team Sweep Tosho!!
Please give a big round of applause to all three of them—!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Sweep-san...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...Incredible. I knew it, you truly are—!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep-san! Um, great work out there!
The cavalry battle was incredible...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh! If it isn't Craft.
Fufun, you're free to praise me even more, you know!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly, truly...! Sweep-san is so amazing. I really look up to her...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The one I look up to... a Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So... that's why, after all...
I want to become just like you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, me too!
Even if the aptitudes don't match, even so...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Run all the way through the Triple Tiara just like you! And then, in the Senior-class races, against the girls on the Triple Crown route...!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...???
I don't really get it, but..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's what I said *I* was gonna do, right?
Are you saying you wanna do it too?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: W-Well... you can just do whatever you want, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! Ah, w-well, then—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, right.
—You're fine with just being an imitator.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That sounds... kinda boring.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Copycat... ?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (A copycat? ...Was I? Is that really what I wanted to do?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (What was I yearning for...?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: !! Ah... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I smile at her as she stands there frozen.
...Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival, where everyone gets to shine.
It would be a waste to just stand still here.
choice_data_list: Wanna go watch some other events too?
Want to go watch some other events too?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...
B-But, well...
choice_data_list: Other Tiara Umamusume are competing too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... together with Rhein Kraft,
I toured the many events where Tiara Umamusume were competing.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for all your passionate support! Did I shine brightly today as well?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek, Fuu-chaaaan!!
You look gorgeous today too, so sparkly and bright~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...North Flight-san.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(She also took 2nd in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
And in the Senior year, she conquered both the Yasuda Kinen and Mile CS.
Reigning supreme over the mile in both spring and autumn.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Fending off even Sakura Bakushin O, the incarnation of speed itself... she reigned magnificently as the undisputed queen of the mile.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho!! Beautiful...
aaaand EXCITINGGG!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH!!
Show us what you've got, world-class Umamusume~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...Seeking the Pearl-san.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Winning the Triple Tiara prep race, the Flower Cup,
and then the NHK Mile Cup.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(In the Senior Class, she traveled to France.
And achieved our country's very first overseas GⅠ victory...
She's the Umamusume who opened up possibilities for all of us.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Phew, huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Please watch!
Watch me see this through!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAHHH!!
Dober-san! I'll always be watching youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...Mejiro Dober-san.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(She achieved the Double Crown in the Oaks and Shuka Sho.
Winning Best Queen Umamusume for three consecutive years...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(The Umamusume who defeated even the "Empress" Air Groove
and won consecutive Queen Elizabeth II Cups,
crowned as the queen of a new era.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, every single one of them...
My idols. My dreams."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because they are—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was running... genuinely searching
for their own 'unique radiance.'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The path I decided on, my own unique path...
I will run it to the end without fail. I will achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...That kind of resolve.
That back... is what I've always admired."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —That's why...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to become one too.
I'll chase after my own unique brilliance, too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll be an Umamusume who can show
a "back to look up to" for someone to follow!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...Can I become one? Can I—?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding firmly, I take out the materials.
Ever since then, I've been thinking and thinking in my own way—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, this is what I prepared to propose once she made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer, this race is...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: From the Oka Sho to the NHK Mile Cup... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, there have been Umamusume who tried...
but no one has conquered both yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "But if it's you," I say to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "But if it's you," I say to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's Rhein Kraft... something that none of the Tiara Umamusume
we saw today, or throughout history, could ever achieve—
choice_data_list: I believe you can grasp your own unique brilliance.
I believe you can find a brilliance that's yours alone.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
From the "Oka Sho" straight to the "NHK Mile Cup"... huh.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If I can win both...
will someone look up to me, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Showing that Tiara Umamusume have possibilities like this too...
I wonder if it'll make their hearts race.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Just like the old me used to be—!
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can become someone to look up to.
I'm sure you can become someone people look up to.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I will. ...I'll prove that I can become one!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
From the Oka Sho to the NHK Mile Cup!
I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the buzz of the Fan Thanksgiving still lingers,
I exchange a vow with Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With new dreams held close to heart...
The Classic year's spring was about to begin.
